rationale: P identifies unintended vehicle braking as the behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate T, directly supported by H-3 and safety goal SG-3. Its declared operating conditions match the hazard scenario. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of evaluation, rather than an ancillary control mechanism; P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism-specific timing requirements.
determining_elements: Whether vehicle braking occurs unintentionally—the behaviour explicitly addressed by T and SG-3.
The absence of visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, supported by H-3 as an operational condition.
The declared scope: straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather, matching H-3.
The restriction to braking behaviour itself, without incorporating the mechanisms that observe or control it.
